necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack, corresponding to diagnosis code G45.9. Given the history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia, diagnosis code I49.9, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture real-time electrocardiographic data during symptom onset. This service is medically necessary to correlate these episodic symptoms with potential rhythm disturbances as stated in the clinical indication.
